title: The record that kept the lights on
hook: Two maintenance records disagree about the shutdown. Nessa refuses to blame the newest apprentice without checking what the records can actually support.

sources.title: Nessa’s maintenance handbook
sources.excerpt: Inspect an original record and its context before comparing independent accounts. A conclusion should acknowledge what the available evidence cannot establish. Copies of one report are repeated evidence, not new independent observations. A claim that goes beyond the measurements is an unsupported inference.

aftermath.gardens: The first current reaches the community gardens. New green shoots appear around Tidewheel Mill. Nessa stays to teach the gardeners how to maintain their share.
aftermath.homes: Warm lanterns return to the mill cottages. Families leave lamps in their windows, and Nessa begins a rota so everyone can help maintain the Works.
